# Fallout 76 - Patch Notes – October 25, 2022 (Patch 39)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_41_nukaknights-post-patchnotes39.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Our latest Fallout 76 update delivers a slew of fresh bug fixes and improvements. Read on to find out where things are happening.

##### UPDATE VERSION 1.7.1.19

Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam):** 3.3GB

**PC (Microsoft Store):** 9.8GB

**PlayStation:** 4.0GB

**Xbox:** 9.6GB

##### BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS

##### GRAPHICS

**Atomic Shop:** Various adjustments have been made to the placement of icons and item previews in the Atomic Shop.

**Power Armor:** Players will no longer appear headless after entering power armor with a helmet equipped.

##### ARMOR

**Durability:** Crafted Legendary Weapons and Secret Service Armor now correctly use the Intelligence stat to determine durability.

##### AUDIO

**Merchant:** Selling a legendary item to an NPC merchant for bottle caps will no longer play the note exchange sound effect.

##### C.A.M.P.S AND WORKSHOP

**Allies:** Fixed a bug that could result in the death of companions when leaving a server.

**C.A.M.P. Items:** The Wavy Willard Camping Canoes can be restored.

**C.A.M.P. Items:** Adjustments have been made to the Arm Wrestling Machine animation.

**C.A.M.P. Items:** The Resonator Guitar can now be interacted with.

**Concrete Set:** In the Concrete Set, wall objects no longer protrude into walls with windows.

##### CHALLENGES

**Daily Operations:** Fixed a bug that prevented Blood Eagles in Operations from counting towards completing Daily and Weekly Challenges.

**World:** Updated various headwear to count towards the Recycle a Headwear challenge.

##### EXPEDITIONS

**Enemies:** The Fanatic Foreman can no longer destroy the Foreman Terminal during the boss encounter.

**Rewards:** Weekly Expedition rewards now reset correctly.

##### ITEMS

**Clothing:** The Halloween Pumpkin Pants Suit and Halloween Pumpkin Suit with Shorts are now available for sale at Robot Vendors.

**Food:** Fried RAD Toad Legs and Delicious Fire Hat Soufflé has been sorted into the correct crafting category.

**Food:** Coffee and Sunburn have had descriptions added indicating their effects.

**Weapon Rack:** The Automatic Ax is now displayed on the Gravitronic Weapon Rack.

##### LOCALIZATION

**Achievements:** The achievement “Trogglodished” no longer displays the wrong number in Polish.

**User Interface:** Various localization improvements.

##### QUESTS

**Daily Quests:** Fixed an issue that resulted in some players not receiving daily Sanctuary quests.

**Wealth for All:** The objective marker for “Take Care of Hijack” now points to the correct level.

**Boot Camp Blues:** The quest objective no longer disappears when the player meets Master Sergeant-Mr. Gets too close to Gutsy at Camp McClintock.

**Responder Renaissance:** Skippy no longer turns his back on the player after teleporting during a scene in Responder Renaissance.

**Mountain Bed & Breakfast:** Fixed an issue that prevented players from properly starting the Mountain Bed & Breakfast quest.

**Prevention is better than cure:** Updated text no longer incorrectly refers to multiple blood samples.

**Out of Sight, Out of Mind:** Fixed a bug that prevented “Out of Sight, Out of Mind” from starting.

**Patrol duty:** The prison guard can no longer be affected by enemies
